
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/21601395" title="发布于 2026-07-17 20:47">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">基于AScript的JavaScript脚本语言发布啦</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-first-child="" data-pid="IWfXMzWR">AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，支持扩展多种脚本语言，2026年7月14日正式发布了js脚本语言AScript.Lang.JavaScript，快来试试吧！</p>
<h2 id="h_2060488622424454713_0" data-into-catalog-status="">一、介绍</h2>
<p data-pid="qGV8VmbS">支持JavaScript基础语法和数据类型，以及数组、集合、字典、对象操作。</p>
<p data-pid="wG3SDjnq">支持require引用模块。</p>
<h2 id="h_2060488622424454713_1" data-into-catalog-status="">二、安装</h2>
<div class="highlight">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">package AScript
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-package AScript.Lang.JavaScript</pre>
</div>
</div>
<h2 id="h_2060488622424454713_2" data-into-catalog-status="">三、使用说明</h2>
<h3 id="h_2060488622424454713_3" data-into-catalog-status="">1、注册语言</h3>
<div class="highlight">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> Script.Langs.Set(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, JavaScriptLang.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可全局设置为默认语言
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Script.Langs.Set("js", JavaScriptLang.Instance, setDefault: true);</span></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2060488622424454713_4" data-into-catalog-status="">2、定义函数</h3>
<div class="highlight">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">function sum(a,b) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return a+b;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum(10,20)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> [] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> script.Eval(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30L</span>, result);</pre>
</div>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2060488622424454713_5" data-into-catalog-status="">3、正则表达式</h3>
<p data-pid="J3U7IMzX">js中使用&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">/{pattern}/{options}</span>&nbsp;格式表示正则表达式。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Eval&lt;List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>&gt;&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'hello world World'.match(/world/gi)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, result.Count);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">world</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">World</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>]);</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2060488622424454713_6" data-into-catalog-status="">4、解构</h3>
<p data-pid="jahfWUWO">1）对象解构：支持默认值、别名、嵌套解构。</p>
<div class="highlight">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var {name, age} = {name: 'Alice', age: 25}; // name='</span>Alice'<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">, age=25</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> {a, b = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span>} = {a: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>}; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> a=10, b=100</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> {inner: {name}} = {inner: {name: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Tom</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, age: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span>}}; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> name='Tom'</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> {name: aliasName} = {name: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Bob</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>}; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> aliasName='Bob'</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">9</span> script.Eval(s);</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p data-pid="BBaJEgA7">2）数组解构：支持默认值、嵌套解构</p>
<div class="highlight">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var [x, y, z] = [10, 20, 30]; // x=10, y=20, z=30
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var [x, , z] = [1, 2, 3]; // x=1, z=3
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var [a = 5, b = 10] = [3]; // a=3, b=10
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var [[inner], outer] = [[10], 20]; // inner=10, outer=20
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">9</span> script.Eval(s);</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p data-pid="AV33YgpI">3）混合解构：对象、数组混合解构</p>
<div class="highlight">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var [first, {name}] = [1, {name: 'John'}]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1L</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">first</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">John</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>));</pre>
</div>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2060488622424454713_7" data-into-catalog-status="">5、字符串插值</h3>
<div class="highlight">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var name='tom'; 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">`hello ${name}, 5+8=${5+8}`
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> [] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello tom, 5+8=13</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2060488622424454713_8" data-into-catalog-status="">6、字符串函数</h3>
<div class="highlight">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> String.fromCharCode(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">65</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">66</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">67</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 'ABC'</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>.startsWith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">he</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> true</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>.endsWith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> false</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>.includes(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">e</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> true</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>.indexOf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">el</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>.indexOf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">el</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> -1</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>.lastIndexOf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">l</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>.search(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">el</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>.search(/el/gi); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>.substr(-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 'lo'</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>.substr(-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 'l'</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>.substring(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 'llo'</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>.substring(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 'll'</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>.slice(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 'llo'</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>.slice(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 'll'</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>.slice(-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 'llo'</span>

<h3 id="h_2060488622424454713_10" data-into-catalog-status="">8、数组函数</h3>
<div class="highlight">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>].concat([<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>]); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> [1, 2, 3, 4]</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>].join(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">,</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> '1,2,3'</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>].indexOf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>].includes(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> true</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>].reverse(); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> [3, 2, 1]</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>].filter(x =&gt; x % <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> [2, 4]</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>].map(x =&gt; x * <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> [2, 4, 6]</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>].reduce((acc, x) =&gt; acc + x); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 6</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>].reduce((acc, x) =&gt; acc + x, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 16</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span>].every(x =&gt; x % <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> true</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>].some(x =&gt; x % <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> false</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>].find(x =&gt; x &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>].findIndex(x =&gt; x &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>].fill(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> [0, 0, 0]</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>].forEach(x =&gt; { }); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 遍历数组</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>].pop(); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3</span>

<h3 id="h_2060488622424454713_14" data-into-catalog-status="">12、Promise</h3>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2L</span>, result);</pre>

<div class="highlight">

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var i = 0;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var sum = 0;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">while (i &lt; 5) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    sum += i;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    i++;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10L</span>, script.Eval(code));</pre>
</div>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2060488622424454713_24" data-into-catalog-status="">22、require引用模块</h3>
<p data-pid="Z2GM8dYH">使用require引用模块并返回模块实例，如：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> fs = require(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">fs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)</span>&nbsp;&nbsp;。</p>
<p data-pid="Q1mHahpn">如果父级上下文环境或者所在语言环境已引用相同模块，则不会重复安装模块，直接返回该模块实例。</p>
<h2 id="h_2060488622424454713_25" data-into-catalog-status="">四、fs文件模块</h2>
<p data-pid="Yl4zTHOE">注：服务端项目请谨慎添加文件模块，避免脚本中恶意删除、修改文件。</p>
<p data-pid="kbMEjVHH">1）安装nuget包</p>
<div class="highlight">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-package AScript.Lang.JavaScript.fs</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p data-pid="Jhuafh5W">2）添加fs模块</p>
<div class="highlight">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>JavaScriptLang.Instance.AddModule(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">fs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, new JavaScriptFileSystemModule());</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p data-pid="FD8DWIgN">3）同步读写文件</p>
<div class="highlight">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var fs = require('fs');
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">fs.writeFileSync('test.txt', 'hello world', 'utf-8');

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> instance.put(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, {});
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> instance.delete(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/api/user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, {});
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> mock</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> mockInstance = axios.createMock([{code:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">123</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,name:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tom</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>}, {code:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">124</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,name:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">john</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}]);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> resp = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> mockInstance.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">http://test.com/api/user/list</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> resp.data: [{code:'123',name:'tom'}, {code:'124',name:'john'}]</span></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h2 id="h_2060488622424454713_27" data-into-catalog-status="">六、结束语</h2>
<p data-pid="lWF2n9hY">C#中执行JavaScript脚本有很多开源库，比如Microsoft.ClearScript、Jint、Jurassic等，大家常用哪个脚本引擎呢？不妨试试AScript.Lang.JavaScript引擎。</p>
<p data-pid="-kbvC9d9">AScript开源地址：<a title="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript</a><a class=" wrap external" title="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" data-za-detail-view-id="1043" rel="noopener nofollow"><br></a></p>
